name: Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.mem_ulmSubgroup_limit_iff
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.mem_ulmSubgroup_limit_iff {o : Ordinal} (ho : Order.IsSuccLimit o) (x : G) :
    x ∈ ulmSubgroup p o (G := G) ↔ ∀ β < o, x ∈ ulmSubgroup p β

name: Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.ulmSubgroup_limit
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.ulmSubgroup_limit (o : Ordinal) (ho : Order.IsSuccLimit o) :
    ulmSubgroup p o (G := G) = ⨅ (β : Ordinal) (_ : β < o), ulmSubgroup p β

name: Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.ulmSubgroup_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.ulmSubgroup_zero : ulmSubgroup p (0 : Ordinal) (G := G) = ⊤

name: Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.markedGradedSubmodule_le_hillSubmodule
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.markedGradedSubmodule_le_hillSubmodule (S : AddSubgroup G) (α : Ordinal) :
    markedGradedSubmodule p S α ≤ hillSubmodule p S α

name: Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.ulmDenSubmodule_le_hillSubmodule
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.ulmDenSubmodule_le_hillSubmodule (S : AddSubgroup G) (α : Ordinal) :
    ulmDenSubmodule p α ≤ hillSubmodule p S α

name: Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.ulmLength.exists_zero
statement:
lemma exists_zero (hred' : IsReducedPGroup p G) :
    ∃ α : Ordinal.{0}, ulmSubgroup p α (G := G) = ⊥

name: Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.exists_ulmHeight_eq_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.exists_ulmHeight_eq_of_ne_zero [Fact p.Prime]
    (hG : IsReducedPGroup p G) {x : G} (hx0 : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ α : Ordinal.{0},
      x ∈ ulmSubgroup p α (G := G) ∧
      x ∉ ulmSubgroup p (Order.succ α) (G := G)

name: Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.adjoinElem_eq_sup_zmultiples
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.adjoinElem_eq_sup_zmultiples (A : AddSubgroup G) (g : G) :
    adjoinElem A g = A ⊔ AddSubgroup.zmultiples g

name: Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.adjoinElem_fg
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.adjoinElem_fg {A : AddSubgroup G} (hAfg : A.FG) (g : G) :
    (adjoinElem A g).FG

name: Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.extend_by_one_fg_of_mem
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.extend_by_one_fg_of_mem
    {A : AddSubgroup G} (hA : IsPure p A) (hAfg : A.FG)
    {B : AddSubgroup H} (hB : IsPure p B) (hBfg : B.FG)
    (φ : A →+ B) (hφ : IsHeightPresOn p φ)
    {g : G} (hg : g ∈ A) :
    ∃ (A' : AddSubgroup G) (_ : IsPure p A') (_ : A'.FG) (hAA' : A ≤ A') (_ : g ∈ A')
      (B' : AddSubgroup H) (_ : IsPure p B') (_ : B'.FG) (_ : B ≤ B')
      (φ' : A' →+ B'),
        IsHeightPresOn p φ' ∧
        ∀ a : A, (φ' ⟨a, hAA' a.prop⟩ : H) = φ a

name: Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.extend_by_one_of_mem
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.extend_by_one_of_mem
    {A : AddSubgroup G}
    {B : AddSubgroup H} (hB : IsPure p B)
    (φ : A →+ B) (hφ : IsHeightPresOn p φ)
    {g : G} (hg : g ∈ A) :
    ∃ (A' : AddSubgroup G) (hAA' : A ≤ A') (_ : g ∈ A')
      (B' : AddSubgroup H) (_ : IsPure p B') (_ : B ≤ B')
      (φ' : A' →+ B'),
        IsHeightPresOn p φ' ∧
        ∀ a : A, (φ' ⟨a, hAA' a.prop⟩ : H) = φ a

name: Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.le_adjoinElem
statement: lemma Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.le_adjoinElem (A : AddSubgroup G) (g : G) : A ≤ adjoinElem A g

name: Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.mem_adjoinElem_right
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.mem_adjoinElem_right (A : AddSubgroup G) (g : G) :
    g ∈ adjoinElem A g

name: Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.iso_of_ulmInvariant_eq_of_backAndForth
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Ulmstheorem.iso_of_ulmInvariant_eq_of_backAndForth
    [Countable G] [Countable H]
    (hforth : ∀ s : BFIsoStep p (G := G) (H := H), ∀ g : G,
        ∃ (s' : BFIsoStep p (G := G) (H := H)) (hAA : s.A ≤ s'.A) (_hBB : s.B ≤ s'.B),
          g ∈ s'.A ∧ ∀ a : s.A, (s'.e ⟨a.val, hAA a.prop⟩ : H) = s.e a)
    (hback : ∀ s : BFIsoStep p (G := G) (H := H), ∀ h : H,
        ∃ (s' : BFIsoStep p (G := G) (H := H)) (hAA : s.A ≤ s'.A) (_hBB : s.B ≤ s'.B),
          h ∈ s'.B ∧ ∀ a : s.A, (s'.e ⟨a.val, hAA a.prop⟩ : H) = s.e a) :
    Nonempty (G ≃+ H)
